mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in the federal funds rate over the past quarter signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% in the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) despite UNRATE exceeding 6% in the past month, or UNRATE decline reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly supply index (INDPRO) over the past quarter signals robust economic expansion, boosting investor confidence and equity prices, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 60-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high supply growth (INDPRO > 100) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals peak growth, leading to overvaluation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) despite meeting trigger conditions, or trigger conditions reverse before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) over the past quarter signals stronger economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained GDP growth, or GDP growth reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 3% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising long-term interest rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 3%, or rate rise reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4%) combined with rising federal funds rates (>2%) signals contractionary policy in a tight labor market, dampening corporate profits and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite low unemployment and rising rates, or interaction weakens before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Signs of economic recovery in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and falling unemployment (UNRATE below 7%) in a post-shock regime indicate improving fundamentals, boosting investor sentiment and equity prices, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite recovery signals, or recovery metrics reverse before the horizon.
